body:
STORY-1888 PR 1: BLOCKED on build disk space. No PR is open yet.
The code is complete per signoff C1–C5 and is committed and pushed: branch claude/story-1888, head 1fc72fdfef. C3 is filed as TASK-2168 (child of STORY-1888, for PR 2).
Before the final edits, the targeted run gave 11 of 12 story_1888 tests passing, plus a lib compile. The one failure was the ratchet listing today's 13 unprotected files, which are now in KNOWN_UNPROTECTED. The re-run and the gates are blocked:
  cargo: error: refusing build: target filesystem has 6.8G (1.5%) free, below hard floor (15G); run 'cargo reap --apply' or set AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=0 to override
`cargo reap` (dry run) reclaims 0B. /home/joe/ai/aida/target/worktrees holds 382G of per-worktree targets that are not mine. I have not overridden the floor.
I will resume the gates (targeted tests, make check-ci-fast, make test-touched) when 15G is free, then open the PR and mail you the PR number and head.
subject: BLOCKED: disk floor (STORY-1888 PR 1)
